sources.observation: The forecourt, steep terraces and groups of low and tall pagodas establish the estimated layout within the mapped perimeter.
The foreground square pagoda has stepped masonry eaves, a rounded finial and a low stone enclosure. The surrounding memorials vary in width, height, and number of tiers.

limitations: The cataloged inventory is represented at full density. The available PMTiles and OSM data supply the site perimeter and footways. Of the 228 modeled pagodas, 116 positions are fitted from the oblique aerial photo and 112 are inferred within the mapped terraces. Individual dimensions and decorations are approximations.
